description: A bright orange shopping bag with dark rope handles sits on a yellow tabletop in the corner where two white walls meet, with the left hand resting near the front edge. The right hand reaches in from the right, grasps the bag’s handles to lift the right-hand object up and forward, then sets the bag down against the back corner and releases; the right hand briefly adjusts the handle before lifting the bag again, while the left hand stays mostly still and does not touch the bag.
